title: Bài thi thử nói lớp 10
topics: Family Life · Humans and the Environment · Music
note: Bài thi thử một lần, KHÁC dạng bài kiểm tra nghiên cứu: không tiếng bíp, không giới hạn thời gian, học sinh tự bấm khi sẵn sàng. Nhóm soạn theo Unit 1–3, chưa thầy cô duyệt. Không trùng đề A/B (test tự động kiểm tra).

questions.text: Who does most of the housework in your family?
What kind of music do you like?
What do you do to save energy at home?
How often does your whole family have meals together?
Should children help with household chores? Why?
Do you think music can help people relax? Why?
What is the biggest environmental problem in your area? Why?
Is it better to listen to music alone or with friends? Why?
Your younger brother never helps with the housework. What would you say to him?
Your class is planning a green event. Suggest one activity and explain why.
